messages:
Alice Tran: Heads-up: planning kernel-quant-3 rollout tonight 23:00-01:00 UTC. Canary plan 5% -> 20% -> 50%. Need clear thermal fallback + pin policy.

Ben Kaur: +1. Fallback target: matmul-stable. Suggest canary pin-ttl 30m, regional pin 90m.

Leah Zhou: Infra note: older A100 nodes reported thermal drift at seq>1500 in sims. If thermal alarms hit, we'll isolate those nodes and route traffic away.

Evan Park: Perf sim summary: p50 +6ms, p99 +28ms. Thermal delta ~8C on older cards. Recommend manual gate if thermal advisory present.

deploybot: Preflight started for kernel-quant-3 (triggered by @Alice Tran).
- checksum: ok
- staging-smoke: ok
- perf-delta: p99 +28ms
- thermal-smoke: advisory (+8C on subset)
Preflight: PASSED (advisory: thermal). fallback: matmul-stable.

Alice Tran: Proceed with canary at 23:10 UTC. Hold each stage 15m. No auto-advance on thermal advisory; manual approval required.

Ben Kaur: Rollback criteria (quick): p99 >40ms for 5m OR error-rate >1% for 5m OR thermal alarms on >7% nodes -> immediate rollback and INC.

Leah Zhou: I'll ensure nodes get tagged runtime:kernel-quant-3 for quick filtering in incidents.

Evan Park: Ops checklist for postmortem if revert: node temp hist, kernel_abi, quant-kernel sha, request geo heatmap.

Alice Tran: Thanks team. Sasha, please update release notes and post in #release-notes when ready. I'll monitor during rollout.
